title: Core Quintet #39
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 5:4 aspect ratio, five women in a single row.

A photograph of FIVE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 5 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Norwegian woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair skin with a light scatter of freckles, strong straight defined dark-blonde brows, warm bronze shadow across the lids, a fine brown liner, long lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, soft contour, a muted red-brown lip, long pale-blonde hair in two thick braids and a braided crown, a fierce, steady, commanding expression, sultry, elegant updo hair, real living eyes. Long almond nails, glossy finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her hips and rear so wide. A dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist sits above hips and a rear so massively rounded and projecting that they dominate her entire silhouette from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape. A full round bust above the cinched waist, gigantic thick thighs meeting the rear's curve, thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic — a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs, wide ochre bands following every deep crease, dense spiral floral bands filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back.

Far-left woman's footwear: extreme ochre platform high-heel mules, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Left woman: a real adult Emirati woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, smoky bronze eyes, a soft nude lip, warm golden-tan skin, an elegant composed expression, cool and composed, low bun hair, real living eyes. Long oval nails, holographic finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide. A mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body — the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it. Below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust. The bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel — a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense cloisonné floral wirework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's pose: mid-stride walking toward camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme gold extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Center woman: a real adult Nigerian woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, long braids piled into a high sculpted crown, a bright, joyful smile, bold and confident, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, chrome finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's footwear: extreme magenta-and-gold platform stiletto corset-lace boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Right woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, smooth healthy skin, defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips, long sleek chestnut waves, a poised, mature, confident expression, demure and soft, curly hair, real living eyes. Far-right woman: a real adult Filipina woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, long voluminous chestnut waves, a bright, confident pageant smile, demure and soft, twin-tail hair, real living eyes. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Far-right woman's body art: painted in Moroccan zellige tile mosaic — a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-right woman's pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 5, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 5:4 landscape 8K.
